schema.stock_signals: {code4: {name, sector, size, short_history, long|short: {hold_weeks: {grade, k, cost_bp, lit:[{signal,family,week,n,estimate_bp,own_mean_bp,win_pct,over_cost}]}}}}。grade は short_history=true の銘柄では null(判定なし)
schema.zone_levels: stocks{code4: {close, resistance|support: {low, high, mid, dist_pct, touches, rejected_from_below, broken_up, held_from_above, broken_down, pending, last_bounce} | null}}。低・高は帯の下端・上端(円)、dist_pctは現在値からの距離(%)
